Kforce has a client in Durham, NC that is seeking a Data Analyst.

Responsibilities:
 
  Work with business and technology partners to identify, review, define, interpret, and clarify scope of work in terms of business/data/system requirements 
  Document system integrations and flows, create stories and processes 
  Participate in the development and review of test plans for Quality Assurance 
  Work with business or technology stakeholders in defining problem statements, suggests options and brings solutions 
  Facilitate regular meetings with global development team and customer/team leader. Support project and release planning and testing

  Familiarity with Finance domain and having experience analyzing expense, revenue, client, plan, product, and fund profitability data is preferred 
  Familiar with database design concepts and have worked on a variety of database platforms such as Oracle, Data Verse, Snowflake, AWS S3 etc. 
  Passion for continuous learning drives you to master new skills and stay informed about the latest advancements in data analytics 
  Experience navigating integrated enterprise data and working across multi-functional teams; Can identify alternative approaches and make recommendations on the benefits and shortcomings of each approach 
  Understand and communicate sophisticated concepts effectively to a variety of audiences, both technical and non-technical 
  Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  Adaptable and agile, can conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines and make project adjustments to prioritize effectively and complete tasks in a high-pressure environment 
  Able to work independently with minimum supervision in a highly functioning team under pressure
